entries.def:
προσ-οχθίζω 
[in LXX: Lev.26.15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18.25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95.10, Ezk.36.31 (קוּט), Sir.6.25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;] 
to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3.10 (LXX), Heb.3.17.†
(AS)

προσ-πήγνυμι 
to fasten to: absol., to crucify, Act.2.23.†
(AS)

προσ-πίπτω
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;] 
__1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mat.7.25. 
__2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mrk.7.25 with dative of person(s), Mrk.3.11; 5.33, Luk.8.28, Act.16.29; τ. γόνασιν, Luk.5.8.†
(AS)

προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 1Sa.21.13 (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), Job.19.14, (Sir.34.30 (Sir.31.30)), Dan LXX Sus.1.11 * ;] 
to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: Luk.24.28.†
(AS)

προσ-πορεύομαι 
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10.35.†
(AS)

προσ-τάσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. 
__2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luk.5.14 with dative of person(s), Mat.1.24 with accusative of thing(s), Mat.8.4, Mrk.1.44; with accusative and inf., Act.10.48 pass., Act.10.33; 17.26.†
(AS)

προστάτις, -ιδος, ἡ
(fem, of προοτάτης), 
a patroness, protectress: Rom.16.2.†
(AS)

προσ-τίθημι 
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to put to. 
__2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Mat.6.27, Luk.3.20; 12.25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, Act.2.47 with accusative and dative, Luk.17.5, Heb.12.19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., Act.2.41, Gal.3.19; with dative, Mat.6.33, Mrk.4.24, Luk.12.31, Act.5.14; 11.24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Gen.26.8, Jdg.2.10,…
